title: Shchedryk
attribution: Choral setting by Mykola Leontovych (1877-1921), first performed in Kyiv in 1916, of a traditional Ukrainian New Year's well-wishing song (shchedrivka); the Ukrainian folk words and the music are public domain (the English "Carol of the Bells" words of 1936 are not used). This is the soprano line, a minor third below the original G minor; the rising run uses the melodic-minor C# and D#, which show as out-of-key.
